name: ci
description: Run a configured CI check for a repository. Use action 'list' to see available checks, then 'run' with a check name to execute one. Only checks explicitly configured in $SHAI_HOME/ci.json can be run. Pass 'cwd' to target a checkout other than the current working directory. The check runs in an environment scrubbed of every exported SHAI_* variable and the API keys (PATH/HOME/LANG/TERM survive), so the repository under test never observes the agent's own run/span/session state; a per-check "env" map in ci.json re-injects a variable for the rare check that needs one.

files.hint: copy ci.json.example to it (default ~/.shai/ci.json), then edit the repos map

action.description: Action to perform: 'list' shows available checks for the repo, 'run' executes a specific check.

check.description: Name of the check to run (required when action is 'run'). Must match a key in the repo's checks config.

cwd.description: Optional directory to detect the repository in and run the check from, e.g. a clone under /tmp. Defaults to the current working directory.
